title: Cooperative Graceful Degradation in Containerized Clouds
problem: Cloud operators lack a mechanism to automatically perform graceful degradation of applications during failures or capacity crunch while simultaneously satisfying application availability requirements and operator infrastructure objectives.
motivation: As cloud infrastructure grows in scale, failures affect increasingly large numbers of containers and services; automated, application-aware graceful degradation is necessary to preserve critical service availability without requiring manual operator intervention.
method: Phoenix uses criticality tags on containers to distinguish critical from non-critical services, then applies diagonal scaling—turning off non-critical containers during capacity crunch to free resources for critical services. A Kubernetes-atop controller implements this cooperative graceful degradation by jointly optimizing for both application-defined criticality constraints and operator-level infrastructure objectives. Phoenix handles failures in a cluster of 100,000 nodes within 10 seconds.
key_novelty: Diagonal scaling: a cooperative degradation primitive that leverages application-supplied criticality tags to selectively deactivate non-critical containers, maximizing critical service availability during large-scale failures.
contributions: Vision and framework for cooperative graceful degradation between applications and cloud operators using criticality tags.
Diagonal scaling algorithm that turns off non-critical containers to maximize critical service availability during capacity crunch.
Phoenix Kubernetes controller that handles 100K-node cluster failures within 10 seconds.
AdaptLab: open-source resilience benchmarking framework with real-world application dependency graphs.

metrics.other: critical service availability improved up to 2x during large-scale failures; handles 100K node cluster failures within 10 seconds

limitations: Not discussed; the overhead of criticality tag propagation and the impact of misclassified criticality labels on degradation decisions are not evaluated.
primary_theme: Cooperative graceful degradation for containerized cloud resilience
